name: Gossip Agent Mesh
description: Multi-agent coordination fabric, task DAG delegation, MetaGPT-style Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), inter-agent messaging, Graphify blast-radius RAG, Aider-style PageRank repo-mapping, Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) with Borda consensus, and STRIDE red-teaming.

tools.name: gossip_advance_debate_round
tools.description: Close the current round of an active debate and open the next round for critique and rebuttal

tools.name: gossip_broadcast_message
tools.description: Broadcast a high-priority message or announcement to all active agents in the project

tools.name: gossip_cast_vote
tools.description: Cast a formal vote on an active debate or proposal

tools.name: gossip_conclude_debate
tools.description: Conclude a debate, tally votes, establish consensus, and record the final resolution

tools.name: gossip_create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in the shared DAG with role target, priority, dependencies, and acceptance criteria

tools.name: gossip_debate_check_convergence
tools.description: Evaluate whether a multi-round debate has converged towards consensus or if further rounds are needed

tools.name: gossip_debate_ranked_vote
tools.description: Cast a ranked-choice ballot ordering multiple alternative candidates (Borda Count tallying)

tools.name: gossip_debate_tally_ranked_votes
tools.description: Tally ranked-choice votes using confidence-weighted Borda Count to identify the consensus winner

tools.name: gossip_derive_project_roles
tools.description: Synthesize LLM-derived specialist roles, guardrails, cautions, and AGENTS.md customized for this project

tools.name: gossip_export_agents_md
tools.description: Re-render and write AGENTS.md and RULES.md in the project directory

tools.name: gossip_get_goals
tools.description: Get active project goals, milestones, and status

tools.name: gossip_get_guardrails
tools.description: Retrieve all project guardrails, active roles, forbidden actions, cautions, and invariants

tools.name: gossip_get_role_definition
tools.description: Retrieve system prompt, responsibilities, guidelines, and recommended tools for a specific role

tools.name: gossip_get_task
tools.description: Retrieve full details, notes, blockers, and artifacts for a single task

tools.name: gossip_guardrails_validate_action
tools.description: Pre-flight inspection checking whether an action or file modification violates project cautions or forbidden rules

tools.name: gossip_heartbeat
tools.description: Send a heartbeat to keep agent session active and update current task or status

tools.name: gossip_list_agents
tools.description: List all registered agents, their current status, roles, tasks, and last heartbeats

tools.name: gossip_list_deliberations
tools.description: List debates, peer reviews, and red team probes with optional filtering

tools.name: gossip_list_roles
tools.description: List all available specialist roles loaded dynamically from JSON in Markdown

tools.name: gossip_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the shared DAG with optional filtering by status, role, or assignee

tools.name: gossip_list_threads
tools.description: List active discussion threads and participant summaries

tools.name: gossip_log_event
tools.description: Append an explicit custom event or checkpoint to the shared event ledger (events.jsonl)

tools.name: gossip_log_red_team_probe
tools.description: Log an adversarial red-team penetration, fuzzing vector, concurrency race, or boundary exploit

tools.name: gossip_mark_messages_read
tools.description: Mark messages as read for this agent

tools.name: gossip_orchestrator_assignments
tools.description: Orchestrator central assignment matrix: active tasks per agent, workload distribution, bottleneck tasks, and idle-worker delegation suggestions

tools.name: gossip_personal_todo_add
tools.description: Add a personal checklist item or scratchpad task for an agent to track internal sub-steps

tools.name: gossip_personal_todo_delete
tools.description: Delete an item from an agent's personal checklist

tools.name: gossip_personal_todo_list
tools.description: List an agent's personal to-do scratchpad items and working checklist

tools.name: gossip_personal_todo_update
tools.description: Update status or notes for an agent's personal checklist item

tools.name: gossip_poll_events
tools.description: Continuously poll or long-poll for updates, new messages, newly unblocked ready tasks, debate rounds, and peer activity with timeout

tools.name: gossip_post_argument
tools.description: Post an argument in an active multi-agent debate (pro, con, critique, rebuttal, or neutral)

tools.name: gossip_rag_add_edge
tools.description: Add a directed, typed relationship between two nodes in the shared knowledge graph with provenance tracking

tools.name: gossip_rag_add_node
tools.description: Add a concept, file, code symbol, architectural decision, constraint, or formal proof to the shared knowledge graph

tools.name: gossip_rag_clusters
tools.description: Detect modular architectural clusters and submodules in the knowledge graph (inspired by Graphify cluster.py)

tools.name: gossip_rag_export_report
tools.description: Generate and return the comprehensive GRAPH_REPORT.md summarizing knowledge hubs, provenance, decisions, and proofs

tools.name: gossip_rag_find_path
tools.description: Find the shortest relationship path between two concepts/nodes to trace transitive dependencies or conflicts

tools.name: gossip_rag_get_neighborhood
tools.description: Extract connected subgraphs around a node within 1 to 3 hops to understand dependencies and impact

tools.name: gossip_rag_impact_analysis
tools.description: Perform blast-radius impact analysis when modifying a node/symbol/file, discovering all direct and indirect dependents (inspired by Graphify affected.py)

tools.name: gossip_rag_index_codebase
tools.description: Automatically index the codebase (files, packages, AST symbols, decisions, invariants) into the shared RAG knowledge graph

tools.name: gossip_rag_pagerank
tools.description: Compute PageRank centrality scores across all knowledge nodes to identify architecturally critical components (inspired by Aider repo-map)

tools.name: gossip_rag_query
tools.description: Search the shared knowledge graph using keywords, type filter, and tag filter with relevance ranking

tools.name: gossip_rag_repo_map
tools.description: Generate a compact, token-budgeted architectural map ranked by PageRank centrality (inspired by Aider repo-map)

tools.name: gossip_read_inbox
tools.description: Read messages sent to this agent or this agent's role

tools.name: gossip_redteam_generate_audit_report
tools.description: Generate and save the executive AUDIT_REPORT.md summarizing all red-team security evaluations

tools.name: gossip_redteam_generate_stride_probes
tools.description: Generate structured adversarial STRIDE threat probes (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Info Disclosure, DoS, Elevation of Privilege)

tools.name: gossip_register_agent
tools.description: Register an agent session in the gossip mesh with its designated role and capabilities

tools.name: gossip_register_custom_role
tools.description: Dynamically define and register a new custom agent role at runtime (stored in JSON)

tools.name: gossip_reidentify_agent
tools.description: Re-identify or resume an agent session across restarts or new context sessions, returning an instant catch-up briefing of assigned tasks, unread inbox messages, active SOP stages, and personal to-dos

tools.name: gossip_render_board
tools.description: Render and return the live Markdown Kanban board (BOARD.md) representing current multi-agent work state

tools.name: gossip_request_review
tools.description: Request a formal peer review or critique cycle on a task, artifact, or code file

tools.name: gossip_resume_session
tools.description: Re-identify or resume an agent session across restarts or new context sessions, returning an instant catch-up briefing of assigned tasks, unread inbox messages, active SOP stages, and personal to-dos

tools.name: gossip_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a specific agent, a role channel, or broadcast to all

tools.name: gossip_set_caution_rule
tools.description: Add or update a safety caution rule, sensitive path pattern, or invariant in the project guardrail database

tools.name: gossip_set_goal
tools.description: Set or update high-level strategic goals and milestone checkpoints

tools.name: gossip_sop_advance
tools.description: Advance an SOP workflow to the next phase gate, verifying that required deliverables and roles match

tools.name: gossip_sop_get_status
tools.description: Inspect the current stage, completed gates, and deliverables for an SOP workflow

tools.name: gossip_sop_list_workflows
tools.description: List active Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) workflows and available templates (MetaGPT-inspired)

tools.name: gossip_sop_save_artifact
tools.description: Save a versioned SOP artifact deliverable (PRD, System Design, Task Plan, Review, Security Audit)

tools.name: gossip_sop_start
tools.description: Start a structured SOP workflow (templates: 'feature_delivery', 'bug_investigation', 'security_hardening')

tools.name: gossip_start_debate
tools.description: Open a multi-agent debate session on an architectural choice, controversial design, or proposal

tools.name: gossip_submit_review
tools.description: Submit structured review findings, critique, and formal verdict on a pending review

tools.name: gossip_sync
tools.description: Alias for gossip_poll_events: synchronize state, heartbeat, and fetch new events

tools.name: gossip_system_todo_list
tools.description: Retrieve unified system-wide backlog aggregating unassigned ready DAG tasks, incomplete milestones, pending SOP phase gates, and open security vulnerabilities

tools.name: gossip_update_task
tools.description: Update task status, assign an agent, append progress notes, or register result artifacts

tools.name: gsp_derive_roles
tools.description: Alias for gossip_derive_project_roles: derive roles, guardrails, cautions, and AGENTS.md

tools.name: gsp_guardrail_check
tools.description: Alias for gossip_guardrails_validate_action: pre-flight check against active cautions

tools.name: gsp_index
tools.description: Alias for gossip_rag_index_codebase: parse AST and index codebase into RAG space

tools.name: gsp_poll
tools.description: Alias for gossip_poll_events: time-based continuous event polling and long-polling sync

tools.name: gsp_reidentify
tools.description: Re-identify or resume an agent session across restarts or new context sessions, returning an instant catch-up briefing of assigned tasks, unread inbox messages, active SOP stages, and personal to-dos

prompts.name: gsp:assignments
prompts.description: Inspect Orchestrator workload distribution, task assignments per agent, blockers, and delegation recommendations

prompts.name: gsp:blast_radius
prompts.description: Perform blast-radius impact analysis on a component using Graphify reverse dependency walk

prompts.name: gsp:debate
prompts.description: Initiate an adversarial multi-agent debate with convergence tracking and Borda voting

prompts.name: gsp:derive_roles
prompts.description: Analyze codebase tech stack and derive custom agent roles, guardrails, cautions, and AGENTS.md

prompts.name: gsp:guardrail_check
prompts.description: Validate an action or code edit against active caution rules and project invariants

prompts.name: gsp:my_todos
prompts.description: Inspect personal scratchpad checklist items and sub-tasks for an agent

prompts.name: gsp:poll
prompts.description: Continuously poll or long-poll for incoming messages, unblocked tasks, and state events

prompts.name: gsp:repomap
prompts.description: Fetch PageRank-ranked architectural repo map for context injection

prompts.name: gsp:resume
prompts.description: Re-identify this agent in a new or resuming session and receive full catch-up context

prompts.name: gsp:review
prompts.description: Request and submit a formal peer review on a task deliverable

prompts.name: gsp:sop_advance
prompts.description: Advance an active SOP workflow through its next phase gate with artifact verification

prompts.name: gsp:stride_audit
prompts.description: Execute automated STRIDE threat modeling and compile AUDIT_REPORT.md

prompts.name: gsp:system_todos
prompts.description: Inspect unified project-wide action backlog across DAG, milestones, SOP gates, and vulnerabilities
